results.title: Dayton Dragons return to TV this weekend -- here's how to watch all three games
results.description: Jul. 25—The Dayton Dragons games on Saturday, July 25 and Sunday, July 26 will be televised on Dayton's CW as they host the Minnesota Twins affiliate Cedar Rapids Kernels at Day Air Ballpark. The Friday and Saturday broadcasts will begin at 7 p.m. and the Sunday telecast at 1 p.m. Tom Nichols, in his 19th season as the voice of the Dragons, will handle play-by-play for all three games. results.title: Book on spiritual status of Ghana launched
results.description: Christian Minister and Writer, Reverend Adotei E. Abraham, has launched a book exploring Ghana’s purported spiritual and geographical significance as a centre of the world. Titled: “Ghana: A blessing in the midst of the earth”, the book examines the country’s alleged status as a “Kingdom centre” and the implications of that status for Ghana’s identity and development.
